name: enh-231-home-parity
title: Catch-up ⟷ Projects Home — parity audit
intro_html:
Already carried into Catch-up (no action needed): project hue + age, the last-response snippet, the click-to-focus / fork / resume contract + its fork-confirm & error modals, the 30s active-only poll (BUG-046), and the scheduled cron badge. By design, project grouping → attention columns, and hero/spine → full/compact tiers.

Below are the gaps and bugs from your walk. Rate each: P0 = carry in before merge · P1 = next · P2 = later/backlog · Skip = don't carry. 🐞 = broken behavior, ❌ = missing, ⚠️ = partial.

items.title: Live / running indicator on cards
items.subtitle: 🐞 broken — prior Home showed a green 'open' pill / amber 'running' pill
items.what_fixes: Prior Home put a green 'open' pill (running in a Duo terminal) or amber 'running' pill (external) on every live session, with a tooltip. Catch-up has only a faint pulse dot you said you can't read as 'this is live'. Bring back the explicit pill + tooltip. (Same-affordance principle across both Home views.)

items.title: Click a live session → FOCUS it, never fork
items.subtitle: 🐞 bug — a running session offered to fork instead of focusing
items.what_fixes: Prior Home focuses a Duo-hosted live session on click. In catch-up, clicking a running one offered to FORK — the liveness join is attributing it as external (or not seeing the Duo tab). The focus-not-fork contract has to hold here too.

items.title: Re-enter a session whose worktree was deleted
items.subtitle: 🐞 broken — `claude --resume` fails 'No conversation found'
items.what_fixes: Many Done sessions ran in worktrees since removed. Clicking cd's to the gone worktree, falls back to its parent, and `claude --resume <uuid>` fails (the transcript lives under the worktree's encoded project dir, unreachable from the parent). Needs a different approach: resume from the correct project dir, OR open the transcript read-only, OR suppress re-entry when the cwd is gone and offer 'view transcript'.

items.title: Click a file chip → open the file
items.subtitle: ❌ missing — files shown but inert
items.what_fixes: Prior Home's recent-file chips open the file in Duo on click. Catch-up renders files-in-flight chips but they don't respond to clicks. Wire them to open in the editor / canvas (the same `duo-home-open-file` path).

items.title: Expand a compact (stalled) row into a full card
items.subtitle: ❌ missing — you requested this
items.what_fixes: Compact rows under Done are one-liners with no way to see detail. You want them to expand into the same card anatomy (goal · You asked · todos · files · actions) — a disclosure toggle, or click-to-expand-in-place.

items.title: Explicit 'done' indicator on finished items
items.subtitle: ❌ missing — you requested this
items.what_fixes: A finished session reads as done only by which column it's in. You want an explicit ✓ 'done' badge on the card (and especially on compact rows) so the state is unambiguous at a glance.

items.title: Greeting / orientation line
items.subtitle: ❌ missing
items.what_fixes: Prior Home opens with 'Good morning, Geoff — N sessions open' and a clickable freshest-session. Catch-up jumps straight to the board with no greeting or 'here's where you are' line.

items.title: Use the session's TITLE (your /rename · Haiku) as the heading
items.subtitle: ⚠️ partial — catch-up uses the goal text
items.what_fixes: Prior Home titles a session via the ladder: custom-title (/rename) → ai-title (Haiku) → first prompt. Catch-up uses the cleaned first prompt ('goal') and ignores a /rename or Claude's auto-title. Decide: keep 'goal', or prefer the title ladder (or show both).

items.title: Cron job management (run · pause · edit · rm · + Schedule)
items.subtitle: ❌ missing — only a 'scheduled' badge
items.what_fixes: Prior Home nests cron jobs under their project with full controls + a per-project '+ Schedule', plus an aggregated 'Scheduled' section for unsurfaced jobs. Catch-up only badges a cron-minted SESSION; there's no way to manage the jobs themselves from here.

items.title: Worktree / subpath badge on a card
items.subtitle: ⚠️ partial — repo label only
items.what_fixes: Prior Home tags a session with its worktree/subpath so two worktrees of one repo are distinguishable. Catch-up shows the cwd basename only — and (per BUG-worktree) doesn't flag a worktree that's gone.

items.title: Overall empty state
items.subtitle: ⚠️ partial — bare '—' per column
items.what_fixes: Prior Home has a friendly 'No projects yet — open a folder…' empty state. Catch-up shows a bare '—' in each column when there's nothing at all.

items.title: Dismiss / mark-reviewed — drop a session off the board
items.subtitle: ⏸ deferred (PRD D6b) — needs an SOR decision
items.what_fixes: No native Claude 'done' flag: the CLI sessions-index has no status; Claude DESKTOP's per-session local_*.json has an `isArchived` boolean but only Desktop reads/writes it. Options for the source-of-record: (a) Duo-owned `dismissed` annotation in home-state.json — where review-state already lives per the §D9 ADR; (b) the Desktop `isArchived` sidecar — Claude-native-ish but round-trips with Desktop only, not the CLI; (c) a custom-title sentinel appended to the JSONL — true session-SOR but co-opts the title + a guarded append. Rate priority + note your SOR pick in the notes.
